title: Tax calculation for invoices

requirements.text: Subtotals are computed from quantity times unit price in integer minor units, with overflow and invalid lines rejected
Tax is computed from a rate with exact arithmetic and a declared rounding rule
Lines can carry different rates or exemptions, and the invoice shows a breakdown per rate
The rate is determined from seller/buyer location and product tax category using a maintained source
Tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive prices are both supported, and discounts apply before tax
Per-line tax amounts reconcile exactly with the invoice tax total
An issued invoice keeps the rates and amounts used; later rate changes do not alter it

evidence.name: storefront and utility sources compile strictly and behave
storefront and utility sources compile strictly and behave

implementations.notes: One invoice-level basis-point rate with half-up bigint rounding; the test asserts totals and an exact large-value case
